column1: # Conformance skip list: suite<TAB>pattern<TAB>reason (patterns are test-id
# globs). A skip is visible debt -- skipped tests appear in the scoreboard
# with the reason. Stale patterns (matching no test) fail the run.
# Note: test/rbs* (RBS extraction, deferred by plan decision) is never
# discovered by the spinel suite adapter, so it needs no entry here.
# The C project's private FFI DSL: bare `ffi_func`/`ffi_buffer`/`ffi_const`/
# with no `require`. CRuby rejects every one of these programs
# (`undefined method 'ffi_func' for module M (NoMethodError)`), so passing them
# would mean spinel accepts source CRuby does not -- a divergence the
# zero-divergence north star rules out. These goldens were only ever checked
# against the old C implementation, never the ruby oracle.
# NOT skipped -- see ffi_gem_compat, which stays live. Porting these 28 onto
# that API would make them oracle-truthful; until then they are visible debt.
